clips.title: The story
paras: The Ashenvale Hunt is a directive guiding proven Horde adventurers out of the arid Barrens and northward into the dense forests of Ashenvale. Entrusted by Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo, travelers are sent to Splintertree Post to assist Senani Thunderheart and test their tracking skills against a wild, contested land.

After proving their hunting prowess in the sun-bleached plains of the Barrens, Horde hunters and warriors are directed toward an entirely different proving ground. Jorn Skyseer recognizes when a traveler has outgrown the local game and points them north to Ashenvale. For the young Horde, these ancient woodlands represent both a bounty of resources and a profound political and spiritual frontier that they must learn to understand and claim.

Following the winding road north past the Mor'shan Rampart brings travelers to Splintertree Post, a fortified Horde encampment nestled deep within the tree line. There, the tauren huntress Senani Thunderheart welcomes seasoned arrivals looking for greater tests of survival. To thrive in Ashenvale, the Horde relies on skilled trackers who can navigate not only aggressive native predators, but also the hostile watchful eyes of the forest's defenders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your strength impresses me, adventurer. Your willingness to embrace the hunt gives me confidence that you could move on to bigger game... And bigger challenges.

The forests of Ashenvale represent a vast untamed wild that the Horde seeks to impose its own will upon, both politically and spiritually. If you seek to prove yourself in an unproven land, seek the guidance of Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post. The outpost is due north of the path leading from the Barrens.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome to the new frontier, friend. Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young adventurer like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.
Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
